_: Name, description and badge live in src/resources/connectors.json so the console and the browser process cannot disagree about them.

notes: Asana scopes are <resource>:<action>. Requesting the "default" scope instead grants everything the user can do, which is far more than any task here needs.

Asana has publicly acknowledged that granular read-only coverage is incomplete; where a needed scope does not exist, prefer a personal access token restricted by the user rather than widening to default.

personal_token.label: Personal access token
notes: A PAT carries the full permissions of the person who made it, so it is the less safe option here despite being simpler. Prefer OAuth for Asana.

rate_limits.note: Around 150 requests per minute for free plans and 1500 for paid, plus a separate lower limit on search.

notes: The token endpoint is the documented pair of the authorize URL; it was not separately confirmed against Asana, which this container cannot reach.
